policy: This matrix is bounded. It records capability, deployment, licensing, dependency, byte-cost, and content-hypothesis facts only. No additional prototype enters NW-11; every further prototype requires a separately scoped follow-up issue.

features.content_hypothesis: A Vulkan 1.4 backend could broaden supported platforms, but the frozen NW-07 production is a Windows D3D12 graph-derived artifact and a second production backend is explicitly out of scope.
features.api_requirements: Vulkan 1.4 loader plus instance/device extension promotion; SPIR-V 1.6 shader modules
features.toolchain_requirements: glslang or DXC SPIR-V backend; Vulkan SDK validation layers during development only
features.runtime_requirements: Vulkan 1.4 loader and ICD on the target machine; Windows 11 driver support
deployment_constraints: requires a second production backend, forbidden by NW-11
loader/ICD discovery must not become a common-profile dependency
NW-07 D3D12 evidence contracts cannot be reused unchanged
licensing_constraints: Vulkan SDK and validation layers are optional development tools, never distributed
loader redistribution bytes must be counted if ever deployed

byte_cost.basis: No deployed loader/ICD bytes exist because NW-11 adds no Vulkan artifact; a future backend would count the loader and SPIR-V payload.

features.content_hypothesis: Overlapping NW-07 bloom/tonemap compute work with the instanced raster pass might reduce end-to-end frame time on devices with an independent compute queue.
features.api_requirements: D3D12 compute queue plus cross-queue fences; no new API tier
deployment_constraints: no extra distributed bytes expected beyond command-list wiring
must not weaken the single-direct-queue common profile contract
requires capacity/occupancy measurements before adoption
licensing_constraints: no vendor SDK or license change

byte_cost.basis: Reuses the existing compiled compute shaders; only common code paths would change, which NW-11 forbids.

features.content_hypothesis: Work Graphs could collapse the NW-07 initialization dispatches into a single GPU-driven producer/consumer graph, but initialization is already amortized and the benefit is content-dependent.
features.api_requirements: Agility SDK exposing D3D12 Work Graphs; D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS21
features.toolchain_requirements: Agility SDK matching the Work Graphs contract; DXC with Work Graphs support
features.runtime_requirements: Windows 11 plus Agility SDK redistributable or inbox-equivalent support
deployment_constraints: Agility SDK binaries must be counted if bundled
Work Graphs can never become a common-profile requirement
requires a separate experimental profile and fallback
licensing_constraints: Agility SDK is Microsoft-licensed redistribution; bytes and notices must be counted

byte_cost.basis: No Work Graphs payload is distributed in NW-11; a future bundle must count the Agility SDK DLL bytes plus shader payload.

features.content_hypothesis: SER might improve ray-query variant divergence if the NW-07 torus reflection workload showed coherent hit grouping, but the initial ray-query experiment must first establish end-to-end benefit.
features.api_requirements: D3D12 SER API; Agility SDK exposing D3D12_OPTIONS21
features.toolchain_requirements: DXC with SER intrinsics; Agility SDK matching SER
features.runtime_requirements: Windows 11 plus Agility SDK or driver support
deployment_constraints: cannot be combined with the initial NW-11 ray-query experiment
must retain the separately exported common fallback
requires per-device matched evidence
licensing_constraints: Microsoft Agility SDK redistribution only if deployed; bytes counted

byte_cost.basis: No SER shader byte is part of NW-11; a follow-up must count shader payload and any Agility SDK bytes.

features.content_hypothesis: Opacity micromaps could accelerate alpha-tested foliage, but the NW-07 torus workload is fully opaque and contains no alpha-test content, so there is no content hypothesis for this task.
features.api_requirements: D3D12 opacity micromap build/copy APIs; Agility SDK or equivalent
features.toolchain_requirements: DXC with opacity micromap support; Agility SDK matching the API
features.runtime_requirements: Windows 11 plus required Agility SDK redistribution
deployment_constraints: no relevant content in the frozen torus workload
micromap data bytes would be content-specific and must be counted
never becomes a common-profile requirement
licensing_constraints: Microsoft Agility SDK redistribution only if deployed; bytes counted

byte_cost.basis: No micromap payload exists for the opaque torus scene; a future content set must count micromap storage.

features.content_hypothesis: Micromesh/clustered geometry could reduce the NW-07 torus vertex/index footprint or improve tiny-triangle rasterization, but the current torus is only 2,048 vertices and sparse; the byte/benefit hypothesis is weak.
features.api_requirements: Mesh shaders plus vendor micromesh extension/SDK
features.toolchain_requirements: Vendor SDK/toolchain for micromesh preprocessing; pinned DXC for mesh shaders
features.runtime_requirements: Vendor driver support plus optional SDK runtime
deployment_constraints: vendor SDK bytes and model/preprocessed data must be counted
substantial licensing review required
no common-profile inclusion
licensing_constraints: NVIDIA micromesh/clustered geometry SDK terms must be reviewed before distribution
preprocessed asset bytes are optional and fully counted

byte_cost.basis: The frozen torus uses 2,048 vertices and 12,288 indices; a micromesh payload could be larger than the baseline and must be measured before any follow-up.

features.content_hypothesis: Tensor/neural shading could denoise the ray-query reflection or infer material response, but it introduces model weights and vendor runtime dependencies that are disproportionate to the 256-instance torus scene.
exact_feature_queries: cooperative matrix / tensor core extension queries exposed by the selected vendor runtime
D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS.../shader model support for the selected neural shader target
vendor runtime capability enumeration before any model load
features.api_requirements: Vendor neural-shading SDK/runtime plus D3D12 or Vulkan cooperative-matrix support
shader_targets: neural shader target supplied by vendor toolkit
features.toolchain_requirements: Vendor model compiler/runtime; exact version must be pinned per experiment
features.runtime_requirements: Vendor inference runtime and compatible driver
deployment_constraints: model weights and runtime DLLs are optional and fully counted
model weights must never enter a common or fallback artifact
requires a separate bounded follow-up with quality and licensing review
licensing_constraints: SDK, model weights, and redistribution terms must be reviewed independently
no weight or SDK byte is distributed by NW-11

byte_cost.basis: No model weights or SDK runtime are distributed in NW-11; a follow-up must count both, likely dominating the 256 KiB common budget.
No DLSS runtime, NGX payload, or model is distributed by NW-11; a future profile must count every byte.

vendor_optional_costs.licensing_note: NVIDIA DLSS redistribution terms and SDK notice obligations apply only if a future experiment opts in.

byte_cost.basis: No RTX Kit component is distributed by NW-11; any future component must be counted.

vendor_optional_costs.licensing_note: NVIDIA RTX Kit SDK license review is required before any distribution.

byte_cost.basis: No model weight is distributed by NW-11; weights are explicitly optional and counted in any follow-up.

vendor_optional_costs.licensing_note: Model weight licenses are independent of code licenses and must be reviewed per model.

byte_cost.basis: No vendor SDK component is distributed by NW-11; every DLL, data file, and notice is optional and counted.

vendor_optional_costs.licensing_note: Each vendor SDK has separate redistribution terms; none is a common-profile dependency.
